**Project Description**  
The budget system of China Railway No.2 Engineering Group (CREG) consists of four parts: target definition, budget preparation, analysis, and control. During the pilot phase, in addition to the headquarters, three business sectors—infrastructure construction, real estate, and material trading—participated in the comprehensive budgeting process. Noah Ark provided Oracle Hyperion Planning implementation services, including budget system consulting and optimization, budget software platform design and planning, Oracle Hyperion system technical architecture design, system budget dimension and model design and construction, system performance design and optimization, and comprehensive professional implementation and maintenance services. This effectively integrated the professional management requirements of budget management as a core tool of management accounting with the powerful and flexible functionalities of the Oracle software system. The project had a long cycle, high specialization, and considerable complexity, particularly due to the large team size, requiring extensive coordination to ensure timely and high-quality completion.  

**Project Responsibilities**  
1. In the early stages, responsible for the budget preparation implementation for CREG headquarters and the material trading sector using Oracle Hyperion Planning, with a team of approximately 15 members.  
2. During the mid-phase, participated in the implementation of the budget control system across all four business sectors, contributing to data warehouse design and interface development with other business systems using Oracle Hyperion Planning, with a team of around 8 members.  
3. In the later phase, led the research, design, and implementation of budget analysis using Oracle BIEE, with a team of about 5 members.  

**Project Achievements**  
Completed the project strictly according to the implementation plan, earning high trust and praise from the client.
